paper_title: Tur[k]ingBench A Challenge Benchmark for Web Agents
caption: Distribution of errors in a single run of GPT4 across all tasks
model_annotation: The donut chart titled “Distribution of Errors with GPT-4” visually represents the proportional breakdown of response outcomes for GPT-4 across all tasks in a single run, as reported in the Tur[k]ingBench benchmark. The chart is segmented into six distinct categories, each labeled with its percentage and color-coded: the largest segment, “Incorrect,” occupies 43.6% and is colored blue; “Correct” accounts for 31.6% and is red; “Partial” represents 11.3% in yellow; “Unknown” is 8.3% in orange; “Syntax Error” is 2.3% in green; and “Bad Response” is the smallest at 1.5%, shown in teal. Each segment is connected via a leader line to its corresponding label and percentage value, positioned outside the chart for clarity. The central white hole gives the chart its donut appearance, and the overall layout emphasizes the dominance of incorrect responses, followed by correct ones, with the remaining categories forming progressively smaller portions of the distribution.
